title: Conformance: streaming, procedural generation, analog input
description: Core-level: chunk streaming, chunkEnter generation with hash/noise/repeat, sleeping and waking entities, analog axes. No trig, no pow.

do: repeat (3 + floor(hash(event.cx, event.cy, 1) * 5)) { let px = event.x + hash(event.cx, event.cy, 10 + i) * event.size; let py = event.y + hash(event.cx, event.cy, 30 + i) * event.size; spawn(noise(px / 90, py / 90, 7) > 0.5 ? 'gem' : 'dot', {x: px, y: py, tags: [noise(px / 90, py / 90, 7) > 0.5 ? 'gem' : 'dot']}); state.made += 1 }

rules.do: state.hud = 'GOT ' + str(first('player').data.got) + ' MADE ' + str(state.made) + ' E' + str(state.enters) + ' L' + str(state.leaves) + ' N' + str(count('dot') + count('gem'))
